title: Sound as the player: four stages (A/B/C/D)
intro: Take over your main pawn first, then walk ~15 m away from the Arisen (near a wall, cave or building is ideal). Headphones help. Press End to start.

steps.text: A (normal): sprint until out of breath, swing, jump, walk near the wall. Listen: whose breathing / steps sound close? Does the place sound right?
B: the pawn now has the player's sound settings, the Arisen a pawn's. Same actions. Different?
steps.each_frame:
local d = _G.DPC_dbg; local s = d and d.state
if not (s and s.active and s.pawn_chara and s.arisen_chara) then return end
local function wc(ch) local go = ch:call("get_GameObject"); return go:call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.WwiseCharacter")) end
local wa, wp = wc(s.arisen_chara), wc(s.pawn_chara)
if not (wa and wp) then return end
if not G_snd then
  G_snd = { a = { wa:call("get_CharacterCategory"), wa:call("get_CharacterRTPC"), wa:call("get_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer") },
            p = { wp:call("get_CharacterCategory"), wp:call("get_CharacterRTPC"), wp:call("get_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer") }, wa = wa, wp = wp }
end
wp:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.a[1]); wp:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.a[2]); wp:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.a[3])
wa:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.p[1]); wa:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.p[2]); wa:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.p[3])

steps.text: B + C: loudness is now worked out from the camera, not from the Arisen. Different?

local function wc(ch) local go = ch:call("get_GameObject"); return go:call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.WwiseCharacter")) end

end
wp:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.a[1]); wp:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.a[2]); wp:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.a[3])
wa:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.p[1]); wa:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.p[2]); wa:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.p[3])

local drv = sdk.find_type_definition("via.simplewwise.Driver")
if G_dec_old == nil then G_dec_old = drv:get_method("get_CalcDistanceDecayAtPlayerPos"):call(nil) end
drv:get_method("set_CalcDistanceDecayAtPlayerPos(System.Boolean)"):call(nil, false)

steps.text: B + C + D: the place's acoustics (reverb, ambience) now follow the pawn too. Different?
steps.each_frame:
local d = _G.DPC_dbg; local s = d and d.state
if not (s and s.active and s.pawn_chara and s.arisen_chara) then return end
local function wc(ch) local go = ch:call("get_GameObject"); return go:call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.WwiseCharacter")) end
local wa, wp = wc(s.arisen_chara), wc(s.pawn_chara)
if not (wa and wp) then return end
if not G_snd then
  G_snd = { a = { wa:call("get_CharacterCategory"), wa:call("get_CharacterRTPC"), wa:call("get_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer") },
            p = { wp:call("get_CharacterCategory"), wp:call("get_CharacterRTPC"), wp:call("get_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer") }, wa = wa, wp = wp }
end
wp:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.a[1]); wp:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.a[2]); wp:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.a[3])
wa:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.p[1]); wa:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.p[2]); wa:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.p[3])

local drv = sdk.find_type_definition("via.simplewwise.Driver")
if G_dec_old == nil then G_dec_old = drv:get_method("get_CalcDistanceDecayAtPlayerPos"):call(nil) end
drv:get_method("set_CalcDistanceDecayAtPlayerPos(System.Boolean)"):call(nil, false)

G_sd_on = true
if not G_sd_hooked then
  G_sd_hooked = true
  local function pawn() local d = _G.DPC_dbg; local s = d and d.state; return s and s.active and s.pawn_chara end
  local t = sdk.find_type_definition("app.SoundSpaceManager")
  for _, n in ipairs({ "updateFieldAIArea", "updateSemiEnvPhase1", "<updateGlobalParam>g__updatePlayerPosY|259_0" }) do
    local m = t:get_method(n)
    if m then
      sdk.hook(m, function(args)
        local st = thread.get_hook_storage(); st.sd = nil
        local p = G_sd_on and pawn()
        if not p then return end
        local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager")
        st.sd = { cm = cm, old = cm:get_field("<ManualPlayer>k__BackingField") }
        cm:set_field("<ManualPlayer>k__BackingField", p)
      end, function(r)
        local st = thread.get_hook_storage()
        if st.sd then pcall(st.sd.cm.set_field, st.sd.cm, "<ManualPlayer>k__BackingField", st.sd.old); st.sd = nil end
        return r
      end)
    end
  end
end

steps.text: Back to normal (all restored). Tell Claude which stage sounded most like playing the pawn yourself, and anything odd.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_snd_done then
  G_snd_done = true
  G_sd_on = false
  if G_snd then
    pcall(function() G_snd.wa:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.a[1]); G_snd.wa:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.a[2]); G_snd.wa:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.a[3]) end)
    pcall(function() G_snd.wp:call("set_CharacterCategory", G_snd.p[1]); G_snd.wp:call("set_CharacterRTPC", G_snd.p[2]); G_snd.wp:call("set_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer", G_snd.p[3]) end)
  end
  if G_dec_old ~= nil then pcall(function() sdk.find_type_definition("via.simplewwise.Driver"):get_method("set_CalcDistanceDecayAtPlayerPos(System.Boolean)"):call(nil, G_dec_old) end) end
end

probes.sound:
local out = {}
local function wc(ch)
  local go = ch and ch:call("get_GameObject")
  return go and go:call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.WwiseCharacter")), go and tostring(go:call("get_Name"))
end
local list = {}
pcall(function() list[#list + 1] = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer") end)
pcall(function() local l = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.PawnManager"):call("get_PawnCharacterList"); for i = 0, l:call("get_Count") - 1 do list[#list + 1] = l:call("get_Item", i) end end)
for _, ch in ipairs(list) do
  local w, nm = wc(ch)
  if w then out[#out + 1] = nm .. ":" .. tostring(w:call("get_CharacterCategory")) .. "/" .. string.format("%.2f", w:call("get_CharacterRTPC") or -1) .. "/" .. tostring(w:call("get_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer")) end
end
pcall(function() out[#out + 1] = "decayAtPlayer=" .. tostring(sdk.find_type_definition("via.simplewwise.Driver"):get_method("get_CalcDistanceDecayAtPlayerPos"):call(nil)) end)
return table.concat(out, " ")
